class.name: PsychProjectDescriptor
class.brief_description: Reads and validates a Lime/Haxe Psych Engine Project.xml manifest without changing the source project.
class.description: [PsychProjectDescriptor] extracts application metadata, Haxelib requirements, asset rules, classpaths, defines, and compiler flags from a Psych Engine [code]Project.xml[/code] file. Conditional expressions are preserved as metadata; this class does not evaluate Lime build conditions, install dependencies, execute Haxe, or rewrite the manifest.

method.name: parse_file
method.description: Parses a [code]Project.xml[/code] file from an absolute path or a [code]res://[/code] path. The XML file is limited to 8 MiB for safety.

method.name: get_haxelib_dependencies
method.description: Returns the declared [code]<haxelib>[/code] entries, including versions and conditional expressions.

method.name: get_asset_rules
method.description: Returns the [code]<assets>[/code] rules, including source paths, renames, exclusions, and conditions.

method.name: get_class_paths
method.description: Returns declared Haxe classpaths. Missing paths are reported in the diagnostics array.

method.name: get_diagnostics
method.description: Returns validation messages with severity, message, and optional path fields.

method.name: get_summary
method.description: Returns the parsed application metadata and record counts.
